verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਸੁਖ ਚਾਹਤ ਸਕਲ ਪੰਥ ਸਕਲ ਦਰਸ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th sukh chaahat sakal pa(n)th sakal dharas gur dharas adheen hai ||

en.bdb: All religions yearn for the comfort and peace of the path of Guru-conscious people. All cults and religions are subservient and in attendance to the path of Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਸੁਰਸਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਬਦ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sur surasar gur charan saran chaahai bedh brahamaadhik sabadh livaleen hai ||

en.bdb: All gods and their holy rivers yearn for the refuge of Satguru Ji. Brahma the creator of Vedas also longs to attach his mind in the words of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਗਿਅਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਮੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sarab gian gur giaan avagaahan mai sarab nidhaan gur kirapaa jal meen hai ||

en.bdb: All the religions are seekers of the Naam Simran. By the blessings of the Guru, one gets all the treasures of the world just as a fish receives life-supporting water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਭੋਗੀ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੮॥
verses.translit_en: jogee jog jugat mai bhogee bhog bhugat mai gurmukh nij padh kul akuleen hai ||58||

en.bdb: Just as the Yogis are perpetually immersed in practicing yogic exercises and a worldly man is ever engrossed in enjoying the relishments, similarly the devoted Sikhs remain engrossed in the higher spiritual state through Naam Simran and keep themselves unsullied of caste and creed divide. (58)
